text: ASCII 鲸鱼（DSH 网页插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天区添加可定制的字符海洋背景。它把动画画布放在对话内容后方，并在设置页提供控制。功能包括切换座头鲸或虎鲸、选择 ASCII／汉字／Kanji 风格、调整颜色和动画参数，以及开启对话中低耗显示和毛玻璃效果。适合希望个性化 DSH 聊天界面的用户。不需要 API 密钥；偏好保存在当前浏览器，可选使用本机字体。

ASCII Whales adds a customizable character ocean to DSH chat. Choose humpback or orca shapes, ASCII, Hanzi, or Kanji, colors, animation settings, low-power conversation display, and frosted glass. No API key is needed; preferences stay in the browser.
想给 DSH 聊天界面加一个会游动的鲸鱼背景。
有没有能把 ASCII 海洋动画放在对话内容后面的插件？
让 DeepSeek Harness 的空白聊天页看起来像字符海。
我希望在有消息的对话里也保留背景动画。
怎么调整聊天背景里的鲸鱼颜色、数量和速度？
能不能把鲸鱼背景换成汉字或日文字符效果？
I want an animated whale background in my DSH chats.
Can I customize the character style and colors of my chat background?
ASCII 鲸鱼 的功能「聊天海洋背景」：在 DSH 对话区域后绘制鲸鱼、鱼群与尾迹动画。插件根据聊天阶段和设置决定是否显示，并适配明暗主题。
ASCII 鲸鱼 的功能「动画外观设置」：设置页可切换座头鲸或虎鲸、ASCII／汉字／Kanji 字符风格，并调整颜色、数量、大小、速度、鱼群和尾迹等参数。
ASCII 鲸鱼 的功能「对话中低耗显示」：开启对话中显示后，已有消息的聊天也保留海洋背景；该模式降低帧率和画布像素密度，闲置 30 秒后暂停动画，有操作时恢复。
ASCII 鲸鱼 的功能「字体与毛玻璃定制」：可选内置或本机中英文字体，扫描本机字体需浏览器授权；设置页还能调整输入框玻璃效果、模糊度和透明度。

dsh-ascii-whales README · ASCII 鲸鱼 · DeepSeek Harness：让鲸群游过留白，也游进对话里。

新对话展开时，蓝色鲸群从字符之间游来。细小的鱼群随水流散开，尾迹缓缓隐去；输入框像一片磨砂玻璃，轻轻托住尚未写下的话。打开「对话中显示」后，这片海会留在消息背后，以更省电的方式继续游动；切换会话时，鲸群接着原来的位置游，不会重新出发。

[English](README.en.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/sadjjk/dsh-ascii-whales/releases) · [上游项目](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales)

> 本仓库基于 [Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales) 0.1.5 继续开发，新增对话中显示与跨会话连续海景。演示 GIF 录制于上游 0.1.5，展示空白页效果。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 安装：在 DeepSeek Harness 的 **插件管理** 中导入：

```text
github:sadjjk/dsh-ascii-whales#release
```

完成后重启 DSH。插件默认启用，配置入口为 **设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼**。

更新时在插件管理中重新安装同一地址即可。需要回到上游原版时，改装 npm 包 `dsh-ascii-whales@0.1.5`。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 对话中也有海：默认只在空白新对话里显示鲸群。打开 **设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼 → 对话中显示** 后，有消息的对话也会保留这片海：

- **更省电**：对话中最高 24 帧/秒、按 1× 像素密度绘制，每秒绘制的像素量约为空白页的 5%；空白页保持原有流畅度。
- **闲置静止**：30 秒没有鼠标、键盘或滚动操作，画面自动静止；任意操作即恢复游动。
- **跨会话连续**：整个页面只有一片海。切换会话、打开设置页再返回，鲸群都接着原来的位置游动。
- **透明度共用**：对话中与空白页使用同一个「透明度」设置，默认 0.6；觉得压字就调低。

刷新页面或重启 DSH 后，鲸群会重新随机生成。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 一片海，两种光：动画铺在整个聊天主区域，位于标题、消息与输入框后方。它保留原项目的 ASCII 字符色块、身体弯曲、鱼群游动与扩散尾迹；鲸鱼以不同大小游过，默认主色为 DeepSeek 蓝 `#4d6bfe`。

浅色像日光下的水面，深色像夜里的海。毛玻璃使用中性白／深灰透明层，没有额外的蓝色 tint；经过后方的鲸鱼会自然透出模糊的颜色。

选中的颜色落在鲸鱼身体的中间调，暗面压深、亮面提亮，保留逐格光照层次与身体立体感。两种主题沿用同一套鱼身配色。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：**字符风格** 有三种：

- **ASCII**：原版字符色块，默认内置 **Geist Mono 600**。
- **汉字**：吻部落「吻」，眼睛落「目」，背部落「背」，鳍落「鳍」，尾鳍落「尾」；其余鲸身由水、海、潮、鲸等字铺开，小鱼化作鱼字旁的游字，字随身体弯曲转向。默认内置 **思源宋体**。
- **Kanji**：改编自 MIT 许可的 [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)，保留按笔画密度生成的明暗与捕食文字效果，游动与鱼群模拟沿用 stackedlol/ascii-sharks。

三种样式按近似相同的字符格面积校准颗粒感，采用固定 CSS 像素尺寸，不随窗口宽度变化：1× 时 ASCII 为 8×12 px，汉字与 Kanji 为 10×10 px。
dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：字体离线内置。切换 **字体 → 本机自定义** 可分别填写已安装的中英文字体名称，例如 `Consolas`、`方正屏显雅宋简体`；点击 **扫描本机字体** 并允许浏览器访问后，可从下拉菜单选择。Kanji 使用「中文字体名称」，英文字体仅作用于 ASCII。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：| 设置 | 默认 | 范围 / 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 显示海洋 | 开 | 控制整个背景与配套玻璃 |
| 对话中显示 | 关 | 有消息的对话中以低耗模式显示；「显示海洋」关闭时不可用 |
| 鲸鱼种类 | 座头鲸 | 座头鲸 / 虎鲸；三种字符风格均可切换并保存 |
| 字符风格 | ASCII | ASCII / 汉字 / Kanji；即时切换并保存 |
| 字体 | 内置默认 | 内置默认 / 本机自定义；中英文字体名称分别保存 |
| 眼睛底色 | 跟随主色 | 默认沿用身体底色，可选黑色／白色，字符自动使用对比色。Kanji 默认透明，选黑／白后增加眼睛底色块 |
| 彩色闪烁 | 关 | ASCII / 汉字：开启恢复原版七色字符点缀，不改变身体主色。Kanji 不适用 |
| 海洋颜色 | DeepSeek 蓝 | 可视化选色器；同步鱼群、尾迹配色 |
| 鲸鱼数量 | 3 | 1–20 |
| 鲸鱼大小 | 1.2 倍 | 0.1–10 倍，保留个体大小差异 |
| 游动速度 | 0.65 倍 | 0.1–10 倍 |
| 身体摆动幅度 | 0.8 倍 | 0–3 倍；0 关闭身体波动，仍会沿转弯路径弯身 |
| 转弯灵活度 | 0.7 倍 | 0.1–3 倍；越高越容易弯身掉头 |
| 摆尾频率 | 0.8 倍 | 0.1–5 倍；独立于游动速度 |
| 透明度 | 0.6 | 0–1；空白页与对话中共用，1 为完全不透明 |
| 字符栅格 | 1 倍 | 0.1–10 倍；越大越有颗粒感 |
| 底纹网格透明度 | 0.05 | 0–1；0 隐藏底纹 |
| 小鱼数量 | 170 | 0–1000；0 隐藏小鱼 |
| 尾迹强度 | 1 | 0–10；0 隐藏扩散尾迹 |
| 毛玻璃输入框 | 开 | 独立开关 |
| 玻璃模糊 | 14 px | 0–64 px |
| 玻璃不透明度 | 0.45 | 0–1；越高越不透 |

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：大小、栅格、速度、尾迹在 1 以下以 **0.05** 为步长，从 1 起以 **0.1** 为步长；也可直接输入数值。

座头鲸保留长胸鳍和宽尾叶；虎鲸采用更宽的圆钝头部、短圆胸鳍，以及独立于眼睛底色的白色眼斑与侧腹斑。默认三条鲸鱼的相对大小为 100%、70%、84%。

**恢复默认** 可一键回到初始设置；已保存的偏好在升级后保留，新默认值（如透明度 0.6）需点「恢复默认」才会生效。偏好保存在当前浏览器。动画遵循系统「减少动态效果」设置，并在后台标签页暂停。
dsh-ascii-whales README · 从哪里游来：本仓库基于 [Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales) 0.1.5：上游完成了鲸鱼形态、DSH 集成、主题适配、三种字符风格与全部可调参数；本仓库在其基础上加入对话中低耗显示、闲置静止与跨会话连续海景。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 从哪里游来：动画源自 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)：原作者完成了鱼群模拟、柔性身体、字符栅格与光影渲染。**Kanji** 样式改编自 [michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404) 创作的 **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)**（MIT License，Copyright © 2026 michikusa404），完整许可见 [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE)。

感谢 **Chael-Chael**、**stackedlol** 与 **michikusa404** 公开源码，让这片海能够游进 DeepSeek Harness。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 从哪里游来：固定的上游版本、改动范围与署名见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。毛玻璃实现参考了 [dsh-glass-theme](https://github.com/cnayu/dsh-glass-theme) 与 [dsh-skin-glass](https://github.com/noexcs/dsh-skin-glass) 的相关思路。

dsh-ascii-whales README · ASCII Whales · DeepSeek Harness：Let whales drift through the quiet, and into your conversations.

A blue ocean unfolds behind each new chat. Schools of tiny fish scatter between characters; wakes fade slowly, and a pane of frosted glass holds the words you have yet to write. Turn on **Show in conversations** and the ocean stays behind your messages in a power-saving mode; switch sessions and the whales keep swimming from where they were.

dsh-ascii-whales README · ASCII Whales · DeepSeek Harness：[中文](README.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/sadjjk/dsh-ascii-whales/releases) · [Upstream](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales)

> This repository continues from [Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales) 0.1.5, adding in-conversation display and a continuous ocean across sessions. Demo GIFs were recorded on upstream 0.1.5 and show the empty-chat view.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Install：In DeepSeek Harness, open the **plugin manager** and import:

```text
github:sadjjk/dsh-ascii-whales#release
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The plugin is enabled by default; open **Settings → ASCII Whales** to configure it.

To update, reinstall the same address. To return to the upstream version, install the npm package `dsh-ascii-whales@0.1.5`.

dsh-ascii-whales README · An ocean in your conversations：By default the whales appear only in empty new chats. Turn on **Settings → ASCII Whales → Show in conversations** to keep them behind messages:

dsh-ascii-whales README · An ocean in your conversations：- **Power-saving**: up to 24 fps at 1× pixel density in conversations, painting about 5% of the pixels per second that the empty chat paints; the empty chat keeps its full frame rate.
- **Idle pause**: after 30 seconds without pointer, keyboard or scroll input, the scene holds still; any input resumes it.
- **Continuous across sessions**: the page has a single ocean. Switch sessions or visit Settings and come back, and the whales continue from where they were.
- **Shared opacity**: conversations and the empty chat use the same **Opacity** setting, 0.6 by default; lower it if the whales compete with text.
dsh-ascii-whales README · An ocean in your conversations：Reloading the page or restarting DSH starts a new random ocean.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：The animation fills the chat area behind the title, messages and composer. It retains the original ASCII cell colors, flexible bodies, schooling fish and spreading wakes; whales of different sizes swim past in DeepSeek blue `#4d6bfe` by default.

Light mode feels like water in daylight, dark mode like the sea at night. Glass is neutral white or charcoal, with no blue tint; colors passing behind it are naturally blurred.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：Your chosen color anchors the whale body's midtones, with deeper shadows and brighter highlights that preserve per-cell lighting and body volume. Both themes use the same body palette.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Tune your sea：- **ASCII**: the original character cells, with bundled **Geist Mono 600**.
- **Hanzi**: 吻 at the snout, 目 at the eyes, 背 along the back, 鳍 on fins and 尾 on tail flukes; water and ocean characters fill the body, fish become 鱼, 鲤, 鲭 and 鲱, and every character turns with the bending body. Bundled **Source Han Serif**.
- **Kanji**: adapted from the MIT-licensed [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks), keeping its ink-measured shading and feeding text effects; movement and schooling use stackedlol/ascii-sharks.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Tune your sea：Cells use comparable areas across styles and fixed CSS-pixel sizes, independent of window width: at 1×, ASCII uses 8×12 px and Hanzi/Kanji use 10×10 px.

Fonts load offline. Choose **Font → Local custom** to enter separate installed English and Chinese font names such as `Consolas` or `方正屏显雅宋简体`; click **Scan local fonts** and allow browser access to pick from dropdowns. Kanji uses the Chinese font field; the English font field applies only to ASCII.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Tune your sea：| Setting | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Show ocean | On | Entire scene and its glass |
| Show in conversations | Off | Power-saving display in chats with messages; unavailable while Show ocean is off |
| Whale species | Humpback | Humpback / Orca; saved and available in all three character styles |
| Character style | ASCII | ASCII / Hanzi / Kanji; applied immediately and saved |
| Font | Bundled default | Bundled default / Local custom; separate saved English and Chinese names |
| Eye background | Follow main color | Defaults to body shading; choose black or white, with contrasting text. Kanji defaults to transparent and adds an eye tile only for black/white |
| Colorful shimmer | Off | ASCII / Hanzi: enable the original seven-color glyph accents; body color is unchanged. Not applicable to Kanji |
| Ocean color | DeepSeek blue | Visual swatches and system color picker; fish and wakes follow |
| Whales | 3 | 1–20 |
| Size | 1.2× | 0.1–10×; individual size differences are kept |
| Speed | 0.65× | 0.1–10× |
| Body swing amplitude | 0.8× | 0–3×; zero removes body waves, while the spine still follows turns |
| Turning agility | 0.7× |

dsh-ascii-whales README · Tune your sea：Size, cell size, speed and wake step by **0.05** below 1 and **0.1** from 1 upward; you can also type values directly.

Humpbacks retain long flippers and broad flukes. Orcas have a broader rounded head, short rounded flippers, and white eye and flank patches independent of the eye-background setting. The first three whales use relative sizes of 100%, 70% and 84%.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Tune your sea：**Restore defaults** brings back the initial settings. Saved preferences survive upgrades; new defaults such as opacity 0.6 apply only after **Restore defaults**. Preferences are saved in this browser. The animation follows reduced-motion preferences and pauses in background tabs.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Where it swims from：This repository builds on [Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales) 0.1.5, which created the whale shapes, DSH integration, theme support, three character styles and all adjustable settings. This repository adds power-saving in-conversation display, idle pause and a continuous ocean across sessions.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Where it swims from：The animation adapts [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks): its schooling simulation, flexible spines, character rasterizer and lighting. The **Kanji** style adapts **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)** by **[michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404)** (MIT License, Copyright © 2026 michikusa404); the full license is preserved in [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE).

dsh-ascii-whales README · Where it swims from：Thank you to **Chael-Chael**, **stackedlol** and **michikusa404** for sharing their source, which made it possible to bring this sea into DeepSeek Harness.

See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for pinned upstream commits, modification scope and credits. The glass implementation drew on ideas from [dsh-glass-theme](https://github.com/cnayu/dsh-glass-theme) and [dsh-skin-glass](https://github.com/noexcs/dsh-skin-glass).
